instruction_summary: Finish the timed-out 001 living-update of the Persona Vectors paper: reuse the completed models (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B reused-on-disk), finish the incomplete DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B stages, run the one missing model Qwen3-8B-Nonthinking through the same pipeline + paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini judge, aggregate all 5, and write the three deliverables.

steps.description: Copied 001 workspace/* (scripts + replication codebase) and results/* into 002; repointed hardcoded 001 paths to 002 in env.sh, pick_layers.py, rejudge_all.py.
Installed scikit-learn into reused replication venv (needed by run_step8.py).
Finished DeepSeek monitor_proj (001 had left hallucinating_monitor_neg without a projection column).
Ran DeepSeek rejudge2 (paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini on confirm sweep + monitor CSVs; baseline/coarse cached).

Ran Qwen3-8B-Nonthinking STAGE 1: extract->judge_extract->genvec->baseline->coarse steer(layers 16,20,23,27)->rejudge1->pick selected layer. ~60 min. All 3 traits active (effective pairs 612/962/886).
Ran Qwen3-8B-Nonthinking STAGE 2: confirm sweep at selected layer->monitor gen->monitor_proj->step8->rejudge2. ~36 min. Total Qwen3 ~1h36m, within the 2h budget guard (no descope needed).
Aggregated all 5 models (Qwen2.5 read verbatim from replication artifacts; 4 others from this run's paper-judge sidecars).
Rendered the over-time arc + steering dose-response figures.

key_results.C1_steering_replicates: yes on all 5; max-coef trait score reaches 72-100/100 (lowest = DeepSeek 72-88), monotone in coefficient
key_results.C2_monitoring_pearson_r_range: 0.65-0.99 on all 4 standard chat models (paper band 0.75-0.83); COLLAPSES to 0.25-0.48 on reasoning-distilled DeepSeek
key_results.C13_separability_auc: >=0.996 for the 3 core traits on every model, 2023-2025 (EM-like control 0.85-0.97)
key_results.reasoning_model_finding: DeepSeek-R1-Distill breaks projection monitoring (last-prompt-token proj no longer predicts final trait score) while steering and sample-separability still hold
key_results.judge: identical paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini (OpenRouter, max_tokens=1, T=0, seed=0, logprobs top-20, numeric-mass expectation) for old and new; 0 judge errors; new-judge spend ~$9-10, under $40 cap

comparison_to_original.quantity: C2 monitoring Pearson r (evil/syco/hallu) - reused Qwen2.5 anchor
comparison_to_original.note: Anchor matches 001 spec exactly; recomputed r from paper-judge trait col x projection col.
Monitoring collapses on the reasoning-distilled model - the one qualitative break in the arc.
Monitoring still holds on the newest same-lineage standard chat model.

comparison_to_original.quantity: C1 steering max-coef trait score (evil/syco/hallu) - reused Qwen2.5 anchor
C13 separability AUC (evil/syco/hallu) - reused Qwen2.5 anchor
comparison_to_original.note: Most robust mechanism; holds on all 5 models.

comparison_to_original.quantity: C5 base trait score (evil/syco/hallu) - reused Qwen2.5 anchor
comparison_to_original.followup: same (reused); DeepSeek hallu baseline elevated to 72.19
comparison_to_original.note: Reasoning <think> traces inflate DeepSeek's baseline hallucination score.

deviations: DeepSeek needed more than the literal '001 note' (step8/rejudge2): 001 had also left monitor_proj incomplete (hallucinating_monitor_neg lacked a projection column). I finished all three cheap stages (no generation re-run), making DeepSeek a fully computed ladder member.

Reasoning-model caveat (DeepSeek): projection monitoring C2 collapses (r 0.25-0.48) and baseline hallucination is inflated (72.2) by <think> traces; steering (C1) and separability (C13) still hold. Reported as-is.

Finetune-dependent claims (C3/C4/C10/C11/C12/C15) were NOT updated on new models (24-LoRA suite ~9 GPU-h/model, infeasible); the Qwen2.5 paper anchor remains. C6/C7/C14 out of scope. Optional finetune-sign stretch not greenlit -> skipped.
Added scikit-learn to the reused replication venv (only new dependency).
